supervisory_authorities.csirt: National Computer Network Emergency Response Technical Team (CNCERT/CC)

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China (PIPL)

metadata.scope: Comprehensive privacy legislation with strict cross-border security assessment

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Data Security Law of the People's Republic of China (DSL)
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: CAC / Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)

metadata.data_classification: Core Data, Important Data, General Data

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Cybersecurity Law of the People's Republic of China (CSL) & Multi-Level Protection Scheme (MLPS 2.0)

metadata.grading: Levels 1-5 security grades; Level 3+ requires mandatory security assessment and domestic hardware

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Cryptography Law of the People's Republic of China

metadata.classification: Core Cryptography, Ordinary Cryptography, Commercial Cryptography

cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: Critical Information Infrastructure National Security Review; China Compulsory Certification (CCC) for safety/security parts
cyber_security_mandates.details: MLPS 2.0 Level 3 requires security management center, trusted computing baseline (TPM/TCM), strict domestic commercial cryptography, and annual cybersecurity audit.

data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: Strict localization for Critical Information Infrastructure Operators (CIIOs) and processors processing over 1 million individuals' data.
data_privacy_sovereignty.cross_border_transfer_mechanism: CAC Security Assessment, CAC Standard Contract, Personal Information Protection Certification

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: Dual-Use Items Export Control List (Ministry of Commerce / SCA). Mandatory export licence for commercial crypto algorithms.
cryptography_controls.approved_encryption_standards: Commercial Cryptography Algorithms (ShangMi): SM2 (Elliptic Curve), SM3 (Hash), SM4 (Block Cipher), SM9 (Identity-based)
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: National PQC standardization roadmap under SCA / Chinese Association for Cryptologic Research (CACR).

recipient_authorities: National Computer Network Emergency Response Technical Team (CNCERT/CC)
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Provisions on the Management of Network Product Security Vulnerabilities: Vulnerabilities must be submitted to MIIT within 2 days; incidents must be reported immediately.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
